name: Beca
h1: Growing across Australia, running as one firm
lede: Beca is expanding in Australian water, energy and defence, integrating CQG Consulting and delivering major programmes such as the New Dunedin Hospital. A connected layer gives projects, approvals and resourcing one shared home.
why_p: A completed acquisition, a CEO-led AI story and multi-year health infrastructure delivery all point to the same need: structured, shared operational data.

signals.title: CQG Consulting acquisition completed
signals.body: Beca completed the acquisition of CQG Consulting, a Rockhampton-based environmental and planning consultancy with more than 45 specialists. Beca Australia now has more than 1,000 people.
signals.angle: One shared register for projects, approvals and resourcing across the merged Australian team, instead of re-keyed spreadsheets.

signals.title: A 15-year AI journey
signals.body: Group Chief Executive Amelia Linzey spoke at the New Zealand-Singapore leadership forum about Beca's 15-year AI journey and New Zealand's infrastructure deficit.
signals.angle: AI initiatives need structured data first; Airtable is the connected operating layer they sit on.

signals.title: New Dunedin Hospital milestone
signals.body: Beca marked the blessing of the New Dunedin Hospital Outpatient Building, one of New Zealand's largest health infrastructure investments. The Inpatient Building is due in 2031.
signals.angle: Multi-year programmes stay aligned when milestones, risks and owners live in one place.
